## Technical analysis

### The 50-Week MA — Confirmed Hard Resistance at $81,000

This is the second consecutive session approaching and failing the 50-week MA:
- Aug 27: High $80,862 (within $138 of MA) — did not touch MA
- Aug 28: High $81,484 — briefly penetrated MA, then immediately reversed within the hour

Two sessions, two rejections = confirmed hard resistance. The 01:00 UTC candle (high $81,484) had volume of 202 BTC — the second-highest hour of the session — confirming that buyers were active at the MA level but immediately overwhelmed by MA-level sellers. Until BTC closes a **weekly candle** above ~$81,000, the 50-week MA is the definitive technical ceiling.

### Volume — Bearish Distribution Signal

The defining volume story of the session: the **highest-volume hour was AT the session low**.

| Hour (UTC) | Price action | Volume |
|---|---|---|
| 01:00 | Spike to $81,484 (session high) | 202 BTC |
| 14:00 | Selloff deepens ($79,317→$79,551) | 423 BTC ← highest |
| 15:00 | Selloff accelerates ($78,311) | 239 BTC |
| 16:00 | Session low $76,864 | 402 BTC ← 2nd highest |

Bullish volume distribution looks like: highest volume at session high (demand). Today's pattern was the opposite: highest volume during the selloff (14:00-16:00 UTC), with the peak at the session low. This is institutional distribution — accounts cutting exposure aggressively into the declining price. The partial recovery (17:00-20:00 UTC) occurred on declining volume (174 → 150 → 117 → 76 BTC/hr), confirming the recovery was short-covering, not fresh demand.

### $80K — Support Becomes Resistance

Yesterday's reference close ($80,095.51) was the first close above $80,000 in the August cycle — celebrated as a breakout. Today:
- Opened above $80K ($80,258)
- Spiked to $81,484
- Gave back the entire breakout, closing $77,417 (-$2,678 / -3.34%)

$80,000 is now overhead resistance. For BTC to resume the August bull case, it must reclaim $80,095 on a reference-close basis.

### ★ Strongest Support — $76,864 (Session Low)

The $76,864 session low is the first confirmed support below $80K:
- Tested once (16:00 UTC) during the peak of Warsh-induced risk-off
- Held: partial recovery to $77,417 followed (+$553 from low)
- Volume at the low: 402 BTC — heavy; buyers absorbed at this level
- Status: confirmed on ONE test; a second test is the real binary

A close BELOW $76,864 would signal the August rally is in a deeper correction phase; next support $75,000 (psychological) then $73,000-$74,000 (prior consolidation).

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $81,000-$81,484 (50-Week MA Zone)

The 50-week MA at ~$81,000 is confirmed hard resistance after two session rejections. Evidence:
1. Aug 27 session high $80,862 — rejected within $138 of MA
2. Aug 28 session high $81,484 — penetrated MA briefly, rejected within 1 hour on 202 BTC volume
3. CoinDesk headline: 'Bitcoin rejected at $81,000 as 50-week moving average caps rally'
4. The 50-week MA carries significant technical weight in BTC cycles — it has historically been the dividing line between bull and bear regimes

A weekly close above ~$81,000 is the technical clearance signal. Below it, bears maintain the advantage at the MA level.

### Derivatives — Structure Intact, Not Overheated

| Metric | Value | Implication |
|---|---|---|
| Funding rate | Positive all 12 four-hour periods | Net-long bias; moderate leverage |
| Open interest | ~$56.48B (+$736M, +1.32%) | Moderate increase — spot-driven rally |
| BTC dominance | ~58% | Stable; no altcoin rotation |
| ETF inflows | 9-day streak, $242M Aug 27 | Structural demand, not speculation |

The derivatives picture argues AGAINST a cascading sell-off: leverage is moderate, OI didn't spike, and ETF flows are real-money buyers. This is why HOLD MEDIUM (not SELL) is the appropriate call — the structure is intact, the technicals are temporarily unfavorable.

### What Would Change the Read

**Upgrade to BUY MEDIUM**: Reference close above $80,095 (prior reference close / reclaim of $80K) — breakout confirmed, 50-week MA becomes the target again.

**Maintain HOLD MEDIUM**: BTC ranges $76,864-$80,095; ETF flows sustain the floor; 50-week MA caps the ceiling.

**Downgrade to SELL**: Reference close below $73,000 — the pre-August rally consolidation range fails; August rally is fully reversed.

**Immediate risk-off signal**: A second test of $76,864 that closes below that level on >400 BTC/hr volume — similar to today's 16:00 UTC candle; this would confirm distribution at support and target $73,000-$75,000.
